variants.generalStyle: Whiteboard & Marker — Clean white background (#FAFAFA) with a faint dry-erase grid texture (light gray lines at ~0.06 opacity, 40px spacing). All decorative DSA illustrations rendered in a hand-drawn marker style using SVG paths with slightly imperfect strokes (stroke-linecap: round, stroke-width: 2–3px, subtle wobble via SVG filter feTurbulence at low intensity). Primary ink colors: blue marker (#2563EB), red marker (#DC2626), green marker (#16A34A), black marker (#1E293B). Typography: Caveat 600–700 for headings (handwritten feel), Inter 400–500 for body text (readable). Cards have a white surface with light gray dashed borders (border: 2px dashed #CBD5E1) resembling taped-up index cards. Hover states add a subtle yellow highlighter wash (rgba(250,204,21,0.15)). Drop shadows are soft and minimal (0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)). Spacing is generous — whiteboard feel means lots of breathing room. Small doodle accents (arrows, underlines, circles) scattered as decorative SVGs.
variants.landingPageStyles: Hero: large handwritten-style heading (Caveat 700) with 'NeetCode' underlined by a hand-drawn red marker squiggle SVG, subtitle in clean Inter. Background has a hand-drawn binary tree sketch faintly behind the text (blue marker, 0.08 opacity). Topic pills drawn as array boxes — each pill is a cell in a hand-drawn array visualization (rectangular boxes in a row, index numbers above in small text, topic name inside). CTA buttons styled as circled/boxed items (hand-drawn rounded rectangle border in blue marker). Stats section: drawn as a simple hand-drawn bar chart — each stat is a bar sketched in marker with the number written above in Caveat. Company logos placed inside hand-drawn dictionary/object notation: { google: [logo], meta: [logo], ... } with curly braces and colons drawn in marker. Testimonials as sticky notes (light yellow #FEF9C3 background, slight rotation -1 to 2deg, shadow) pinned to the whiteboard, quote in handwritten font, name/company in clean Inter below. Course section: categories drawn as a hand-drawn tree diagram — category as parent node (circled text), course cards as child nodes connected by marker lines, difficulty as colored marker dots (green/yellow/red). CTA section: left side has a hand-drawn stack diagram (boxes stacked vertically, labeled 'Sign Up' → 'Pick a Plan' → 'Start Coding' with push arrow), right side shows the practice tracker as a hand-drawn linked list (boxes with arrows, completed boxes checked off with green marker). Founder section: hand-drawn timeline arrow with life events as labeled points along it, portrait in a hand-drawn circle frame. Footer: clean minimal, separated by a hand-drawn horizontal line.

variants.generalStyle: Chalkboard — Deep matte green-black background (#1A2E1A) with a subtle chalk dust texture overlay (noisy grain filter via SVG feTurbulence, 0.03–0.05 opacity). All DSA illustrations and decorative elements rendered in chalk style — rough white/pastel strokes with slightly fuzzy edges (SVG filters: feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap for hand-drawn wobble, slight opacity variation along strokes to mimic real chalk). Typography: Kalam 600–700 for headings (chalk handwriting), Inter 400 for body (clean readability). Chalk colors: white (#E8E8D0, slightly warm), yellow chalk (#FDE68A), pink chalk (#FDA4AF), blue chalk (#93C5FD), green chalk (#86EFAC). Cards have no solid borders — instead, chalk-drawn rectangles with imperfect corners. Erased smudge effects (blurred white patches at ~0.03 opacity) scattered as texture. No box-shadows — depth created by chalk line weight variation. Hover states brighten the chalk stroke opacity. Faint ruled lines horizontally across background (like a greenboard) at 0.04 opacity.
variants.landingPageStyles: Hero: large chalk-written heading (Kalam 700, white chalk) with 'NeetCode' in yellow chalk with a chalk-drawn box around it. Subtitle in lighter chalk. Background features a large hand-drawn graph/tree in faint chalk (blue chalk, 0.1 opacity) — nodes as circles with values, edges as lines. Topic pills rendered as a chalk-drawn hash map on the board — a table with index column (0, 1, 2...) and value column (topic names), drawn with chalk lines and text. CTA buttons as chalk-circled text or chalk-boxed text with a slight glow (text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.3)). Stats section: chalk tally marks or a chalk-drawn number line — each stat written large in yellow chalk with the label below in white. Company logos rendered monochromatically in chalk-white (desaturated, filtered to look chalky). Testimonials as sections of the board separated by chalk-drawn divider lines, each quote preceded by a chalk quotation mark, name written below with a chalk underline. Course section: drawn as a chalk adjacency list — category name on the left as the vertex, courses listed as connected edges branching right, difficulty indicated by chalk color (green/yellow/pink). The whole thing looks like someone explaining a graph on a board. CTA section: left side has a chalk-drawn queue visualization (boxes in a line labeled with steps: Enqueue('Practice') → Enqueue('Learn') → Dequeue('Succeed')), right side shows a chalk-drawn array of the NeetCode 150 topics with index notation arr[0]='Arrays', arr[1]='Two Pointers', checked items crossed out in green chalk. Founder section: chalk portrait sketch (or real photo with chalk-frame border), bio written in chalk handwriting style, 'Previously at' companies as chalk-drawn logos. Footer: chalk horizontal rule, links in chalk white, subtle chalk dust smudge at bottom edge.

variants.generalStyle: Retro-Futurism / Cyberpunk — Deep void background (#0A0A0F) with neon accent colors, monospace-influenced typography. Headings: JetBrains Mono 600–700 or Orbitron 700. Body: IBM Plex Sans 400. Subtle CRT scanline overlay (repeating-linear-gradient at 2px intervals, very low opacity). Neon glow effects (text-shadow: 0 0 8px accent, box-shadow: 0 0 12px accent). Sharp corners (border-radius: 2–4px max). Borders: 1px solid with neon tint. Glitch micro-animation on hero text (subtle translateX ±1px). Terminal/HUD aesthetic with technical precision.
variants.landingPageStyles: Hero: monospace heading with neon green glow, glitch animation on brand name, scanline overlay across entire hero section. Topic pills styled as terminal tags (monospace, bordered, neon-tinted). Stats displayed in a HUD-style bar with bracketed numbers (e.g. [1M+]). Company logos desaturated with neon tint on hover. Testimonials as terminal-style cards with '>' prefix on quotes, neon-bordered avatar circles. Course cards with sharp corners, thin neon borders, difficulty badges as colored terminal labels. CTA section styled as a command prompt interface with blinking cursor. Founder section in a bordered 'terminal window' frame with title bar dots.

variants.generalStyle: DSA Visual — Dark slate background (#0D1117, GitHub-dark inspired) with interactive data structure visualizations woven into the design as decorative and structural elements. SVG/canvas-rendered nodes (circles, 40–56px) connected by animated edges (2px stroked paths with directional arrows). Typography: JetBrains Mono 500–700 for headings and data labels, Inter 400–500 for body text. Border-radius: 50% for nodes, 8px for cards. Color-coding follows algorithm visualization conventions: visited nodes (emerald #10B981), queued/active nodes (amber #F59E0B), unvisited nodes (slate #334155), current pointer (cyan #06B6D4). Subtle animated traversal effects — BFS ripple expanding outward, DFS depth-first highlighting. Edges drawn as SVG paths with stroke-dasharray animation. Faint dot-grid background (like graph paper) at 0.04 opacity. Monospace code snippets embedded as decorative accents.
variants.landingPageStyles: Hero: animated graph visualization as background — ~30 nodes scattered with edges, BFS traversal ripple animating outward from center node (nodes light up green sequentially), heading overlaid in center with brand name inside a highlighted 'current node' circle, subtitle below. Topic pills rendered as graph nodes connected by edges forming a small network diagram. Stats section: binary tree layout — root node shows total engineers, left/right children show problems count and video count, leaf nodes show subcategories. Company logos placed inside nodes of a horizontal linked list (node → arrow → node → arrow pattern). Testimonials: each card is a node in a weighted graph, edges between cards show connection (e.g. 'same company'), avatar inside the node circle. Course section: courses grouped by category in a hash map visualization — category name as the key (left column, monospace, with hash function notation), course cards as values in buckets (right side, chained with small arrows for overflow). Difficulty shown as node colors. CTA section: left side shows a stack visualization (push 'Start Practicing' onto stack) with animated push/pop, right side shows the practice tracker as a linked list of topics (each topic is a node, completed ones highlighted green, current has a pointer arrow). Founder section: timeline as a singly linked list — each life event is a node (college → job → YouTube → NeetCode), horizontal with arrows, portrait at the head node. Footer: minimal, with a 'traversal complete' motif — small breadcrumb trail of visited nodes.

variants.generalStyle: Neo Brutalism — Light cream base (#FFFDF5) with bold black borders (3–4px), hard offset shadows (4–6px, no blur, solid black), sharp corners (border-radius: 0). Typography: Space Grotesk 700–900 for headings (uppercase, tight tracking -0.02em), DM Sans 400–500 for body. High-saturation accent blocks (hot red, vivid yellow, electric blue). Slightly rotated elements (-1deg to 2deg) for playful energy. No gradients, no blur — raw, confident, loud. Cards feel like stacked paper cutouts. Press interactions shift elements by shadow offset amount.
variants.landingPageStyles: Hero: massive uppercase heading (Space Grotesk 900) with brand name in a hot-red highlight box, offset shadow on CTA buttons, topic pills as thick-bordered sticker badges with slight rotation. Stats in large bold blocks with colored backgrounds (yellow block, blue block). Company logos in a thick-bordered strip with cream background. Testimonials as paper-stack cards with offset shadows and company badge stickers. Course cards as bold bordered blocks with color-coded difficulty headers (full-width colored top bar). CTA section with large yellow background block and black text, practice mockup in a thick-bordered frame. Founder section with bordered portrait and pull-quote in large italic. Footer with thick top border and blocky layout.
